title: Logray
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: As the Ewok shaman of the Bright Tree Village, Logray's rituals ensured that his tribe remained in harmony with the Forest Moon of Endor. When C-3P0, the great golden god, visited his tribe, Logray ordered the sacrificial banquet of the offworlders in honor of their god. Unfortunately, this incurred the wrath of their god, who used his magic to express his extreme displeasure.
